question: Do the exact-weight-nominated earlier heads causally write the task-typed source values read by the extracted L11H3 interface, singly or as a distributed union?

frozen_design.populations: Run every 128 endpoint in the original and fresh OOD banks with all phase/template/cell/group labels retained. Temporal source is bridge and is-was source is postcue; no position or row may be reselected.
frozen_design.intervention: Capture each nominated native pre-c_proj 128-wide head slice. For a role, replace that slice from the exact command-counterfactual donor only at every locked L11 source position. Run all six singletons plus the frozen role top-five union. In multi-layer unions each selected output is an absolute native-donor tensor; unselected heads/modules remain live.
frozen_design.reference: Separately execute the identified L11H3 c_v native-donor patch at the locked source and score every upstream arm against its final command-margin effect. Replay the reference's stored command-gold fields within 1e-5.
frozen_design.shared_singleton_bar: A prospectively shared head among L6H7/L7H7/L9H1/L9H4 must, for both roles and both original phases, recover >=.10 of the L11 value-reference effect with cosine >=.60 and direction agreement >=.65. The same head must retain nonnegative recovery and direction >=.55 on both OOD phases.
frozen_design.union_bar: Each role top-five union must recover >=.50 of its L11 reference on original FIT/HOLDOUT and >=.35 on OOD FIT/HOLDOUT, with cosine >=.80 and direction agreement >=.75 everywhere.
frozen_design.additivity: For every population x role x phase x template, the sum of the five corresponding singleton effects predicts the top-five union with relative L2 <=.25 and cosine >=.95. Passing licenses a weight-ordered greedy subset successor; failure routes to the complete 32-subset interaction-aware test without changing candidates.
frozen_design.selectivity: Every reference and top-five union pooled phase has cross-role/gold norm <=.01; every is-was arm changes the earlier temporal margin by <=1e-5.
frozen_design.diagnostics: Report whether L5H1 is more temporal-selective than L3H4 and vice versa, but do not gate the registered causal claims on this descriptive contrast.

predictions.pred_a_authority_pairing_reference_repla: Both authorities, source positions, donor pairings, six head captures, all arms, reference replay, finiteness, and literal price pass.
predictions.pred_b_at_least_one_weight_shared_head_i: At least one of the four shared exact-weight candidates passes its complete registered singleton bar.
predictions.pred_c_each_task_top5_union_recovers_the: Both frozen top-five unions pass every original and OOD recovery/geometry bar.
predictions.pred_d_upstream_head_effects_are_distrib: Every registered singleton-sum versus union additivity panel passes.
predictions.pred_e_upstream_writing_is_task_selectiv: Every collateral and later-to-earlier causal-zero bar passes.

null: If A fails, the instrument is invalid. If B fails but C passes, the writer is distributed with no shared singleton. If C fails, exact weight reach did not identify a sufficient upstream source writer set. If D fails, do not run greedy selection; use all 32 subsets of each frozen top-five. Any causal null preserves the atlas as weight compatibility only and cannot trigger threshold, position, or candidate widening.
decision: A/B or A/C establishes causal upstream writing into the extracted L11 value route at singleton or distributed granularity. D fixes greedy versus interaction-aware combination. Passing candidates still require held-out writer-to-formula mediation before joining the executable circuit.
